_comment: Which lines of a model's text are step marks.
`aide-run-spec` records the lines under `recorded` into the run log while the model runs
(core/scripts/lib/run-spec/turn/model-marks.sh); the board shows the lines under `shown` as marks
(`splitMarks`, dashboard/src/queue/parse-stream/shared.ts). The two differ for the older
`analyze · Step` form, which the board still reads and the runner never records.
`text` is one block of the model's text.
